COMMAND ONLY

This page only builds a read-only prepare command. The Agent Wallet CLI shows the full review; authorization and any real order happen there.

Before you start · Agent Wallet and a dedicated Kuru testnet account

To run the command, you need MetaMask Agent Wallet 6.2.0 with the reviewed plugin installed, plus a dedicated, registered Kuru testnet account with custody funds and separate native MON for gas. If setup is incomplete, you can still compose an order here, but the command will not run yet.

Set up MetaMask Agent Wallet CLI (official guide). CLI sign-in and initialization are separate steps; complete them from the official guide before using plugin commands.

Local plugin setup (human review required)

From the repository root, build and install the local plugin. Review the wallet consent prompt yourself. These steps install the plugin only; they do not register or fund a Kuru account.

cd packages/agent-wallet-plugin
npm run build
mm config set experimentalPlugins true
mm config set experimentalAllowUnverifiedInstalls true
mm plugins install "file:$PWD"
mm kuru --help

See the complete local instructions in packages/agent-wallet-plugin/README.md. Plugin installation changes wallet settings and requires your explicit review and consent. Kuru account registration and custody funding are separate setup tasks.

02
Prepare without signing; submit only if you choose
Run the prepare command in your Agent Wallet terminal. Prepare reads account and chain state and saves a local intent; it does not sign or submit a transaction. Read its on-screen review and check the owner, market, side, price, quantity, custody funding, maker fee, separate gas balance, expiry and full review digest.
  1. Stop if anything is missing, unclear or different from the order you intended.
  2. Submitting is optional. Only if you choose to place the order, use the exact intent ID and review digest shown in the CLI:
mm kuru submit --intent <INTENT_ID> --confirm <REVIEW_DIGEST> --exclusive-account --format text
Replace both placeholders with the full values from the review. MetaMask Agent Wallet will handle its own approval. A review digest does not approve or submit anything by itself.


03
Check the reported order status
AGENT WALLET CLI
After the CLI finishes the request, use the same intent ID to check its reported status. A transaction hash or successful submission is not proof that an order rested or filled.
mm kuru status --intent <INTENT_ID> --format text
If the CLI reports an unknown or incomplete outcome, inspect the original request and status with a person. Do not retry or create a replacement while the result is unresolved.


Optional: show CLI JSON reports in this page
The regular workflow ends in Agent Wallet CLI and needs no JSON copy/paste. Use this only if you want this page to format a CLI report. Choose the JSON command instead of the text command before you run prepare; do not run prepare a second time just to change output format. Imported reports remain unverified here.

Read-only diagnostics
This optional browser connection is separate from MetaMask Agent Wallet CLI. It does not connect the CLI host or verify Kuru registration, custody funding, market state or order execution.


Connection, privacy & supported wallets
Supports installed EIP-1193 browser wallets discovered through EIP-6963, with a legacy injected-provider fallback. MetaMask's browser extension exposes this interface. No WalletConnect QR service, mobile deep link, wallet creation or extension installation is supplied here.
Account access and a switch to the already-configured Monad testnet are requested only after you click the corresponding button. Review or reject prompts in your wallet. This page cannot sign or send a transaction, add a network or approve a token.
Address and balance stay in this page's memory. The selected wallet performs reads through its configured network provider. Disconnecting this page clears its display and listeners; it does not revoke site permissions stored in the wallet. Use your wallet's own site-permission controls for that.
MetaMask provider documentation · Official Monad testnet details




Prototype limitations & next validation gates
This browser companion
The wallet panel supports read-only provider connection and native balance. No signing, custody operations, live prices or order execution. Sandbox reviews are disposable numerical estimates, not transaction intents. Reloading resets this workspace and its displayed wallet session.
The underlying CLI prototype
Requires separate human-reviewed Agent Wallet installation and live testnet validation. Actual host policy/MFA behavior and any real order lifecycle are unverified.
Order safety boundaries
Post-only may skip. Fills cannot be reversed. Cancellation releases only the remaining reservation inside AccountCore. Dedicated account use is required; concurrent traders can race a slot check. Local expiry and fee estimates do not cap pending execution.
Evidence boundaries
RPC log completeness remains an assumption. An unknown result requires review, never an automatic replacement order. Production suitability and third-party dependency distribution rights remain open.
